decisions_questions.name: team
decisions_questions.instructions: Which team should handle this support ticket?

choices.description: Charges, refunds, invoices, prices on a bill, subscriptions, billing details
Bugs, errors, crashes, outages, slow pages, API or integration problems
Delivery, tracking, couriers, damaged or lost parcels, delivery addresses
Login, passwords, security, profile, users and permissions, data deletion
Buying, plans, quotes, discounts, demos, trials for new or bigger purchases

decisions_questions.name: urgency
decisions_questions.instructions: How soon does this ticket need a response?

levels.label: Can wait: no harm if answered in a few days
Soon: should be handled within a day or two
Today: work, money or security is blocked right now
